svg.title: One request wakes one actor
svg.desc: An isometric drawing of one request. A client terminal sends POST / through kubectl ate proxy. In the namespace ate-system, atenet-router with the Envoy mark calls ResumeActor on ate-api-server, which reads the actor row in Postgres and binds a worker. Below is the node kind-control-plane with the Kubernetes mark. On it are a worker pod drawn as an open frame, a gVisor sandbox inside it, atelet, and the object store as a bucket. atelet restores the golden snapshot into the sandbox, and the actor my-counter-1 goes from SUSPENDED, a dashed outline, to RUNNING, three solid layers for memory, file, and rootfs. The router then opens a tunnel to port 8443. The first request took 0.358 s, the next four took 0.062 s to 0.091 s, and a request after 900 s with no traffic took 0.080 s.
svg.text: THE REQUEST PATH · AGENT SUBSTRATE V1.0.0
through kubectl ate proxy, x86 server guest
after 900 s with no request: 60 of 60 samples RUNNING
